# Talent, Integration & Rule of Law

> Openness for talent and clear rules — Switzerland as a hub for people who want to contribute.

Source: https://die-zukunft.ch/en/talent-integration/ · Publisher: The Future (Swiss political party, Basel)

## Talent, Integration & Rule of Law

Switzerland thrives on stability, quality and trust — and on people who contribute. We want to strengthen both: **openness for talent** and **clear rules** that apply to everyone.

## Switzerland as a Hub for International Talent

We want people from around the world to be able to research, found companies, work and invest in Switzerland — and for our location to become stronger as a result. This is part of our prosperity model. Concretely: a talent visa for top people in AI, robotics, life sciences and research, with a decision within ten working days, family included and relocation as easy as in Singapore or Hong Kong.

## Integration Means Commitment

Those who move to Switzerland should not just "be here", but **arrive here**:

- Learn the language and orient themselves
- Access to work and education
- Participation in social life

## Rule of Law and Security

Rules are the foundation of our trust. Clear, fair, without hysteria:

- Expectations are clear and apply to everyone
- Violations are consistently enforced under the rule of law
- No generalisations based on origin — responsibility is individual

## Why This Fits The Future

Abundance and comfort emerge in a society that is **open** to capability and commitment — and **reliable** in its rules. Exactly this combination makes Switzerland strong.

## Frequently asked questions

**Do you want more or less migration?**  
That's the wrong question. We want Switzerland to be open to people who contribute — researchers, founders, skilled professionals — while staying reliable in its rules. The quality of integration is what counts, not symbolic debates.

**What does 'integration means commitment' mean?**  
Those who move to Switzerland should truly arrive: learn the language, have access to work and training, take part in social life. It is both an expectation and an offer.

**And those who don't follow the rules?**  
Rules apply to everyone, and violations are consistently prosecuted under the rule of law. But responsibility is individual — no generalisations by origin.

**Why is talent inflow part of the prosperity model?**  
Because prosperity emerges where skill and effort are welcome. People who research, found and invest here make the country stronger — and everyone benefits.
